material.acceptance_criteria: CI job (ci.yml) asserts js/client/play.html has an importmap that maps wireweave to the a71f179 pin and loads play.js as a module; the existing lobby/moba step asserting play.html does not reference dist/ stays. Witness: ci-status on the pushed 40-char sha shows the net-client CI job green.
material.description: Goal: WebGL client page renders map and units from the assets the browser page loads (map.bin, wasm sim in rust/crates/web/site; reuse main.js loaders). Buildless: js/client/play.html loads js/client/play.js as a native ES module through an importmap that pins wireweave to commit a71f179. Joins a room over WebRTC through wireweave createDataSession({fsm, xstate, relayPool, auth, namespace:'oscraft'}) (js/client/play.js:522), room from URL hash (#lobby default). Sends binary order frame on click, draws host state frames. Files: js/client/play.html, js/client/play.js, js/client/frame.js. Do not touch rust/, js/host/, js/wire/; do not add a bundler or dist/. Engine stays genre-agnostic. Owner decision (buildless) recorded in .gm/witness-log.md; blocker net-webgl-client-blocker-gm-orch-1-10 superseded.
